core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. No onward chain.

The ground floor has a lounge measuring 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). There is a lean-to utility. The first floor has bedroom one measuring 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two measuring 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"), and bedroom three measuring 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). There is one bathroom.

The rear garden measures approximately 9m (30ft). There is a gate to the shared rear path. Parking is on-street and no permit is required.

Gas central heating is installed. The Worcester boiler was installed in 2019.

Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction is standard – brick under a concrete tiled roof. Electricity, water and sewerage are mains. Water is metered. Heating is gas central heating. Broadband is FTTC. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. There is a damp mark on the bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. The seller is unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
core.summary: Freehold ex-local-authority mid-terrace house in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham, with lounge, kitchen/diner, lean-to utility, three bedrooms, rear garden with gate to shared path, gas central heating, no onward chain
